client.requirements: Python 3.10+. One file, standard library only, no install step.
client.usage:
from client import QueueClient

q = QueueClient("http://localhost:8080")
q.put("my-topic", {"any": "json"})          # produce
for msg in q.consume("my-topic"):            # consume; polls once a minute
    with msg:                                # acks on success, nacks on error
        handle(msg.payload)
client.note: This is the recommended way to talk to this queue. It handles leasing, ack/nack, retries and polling for you. Download it and import it -- do not reimplement the HTTP calls unless you must.

overview: A multi-topic job queue backed by SQLite. Producers POST messages to a topic; consumers LEASE messages (which hides them from other consumers for a visibility timeout), do the work, then ACK on success or NACK on failure. A NACKed message is retried with exponential backoff until max_attempts is reached, after which it moves to the 'dead' state where it can be inspected and requeued. Nothing is ever silently lost: if a consumer crashes without acking, its lease expires and the message returns to 'ready' automatically.
auth: None. The server was started without a token.

concepts.topic: A named queue. Created implicitly on first enqueue. Name must match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}.
concepts.message: A JSON payload plus delivery metadata. Identified by an integer id.

state.ready: Waiting to be leased. Only visible once available_at <= now.
state.leased: Claimed by a consumer; hidden until lease_expires_at.
state.dead: Failed max_attempts times, or explicitly killed. Inspect and requeue.

concepts.lease_id: Opaque token returned with a leased message. Pass it to ack/nack/extend to prove you still hold the lease; a stale lease_id is rejected with 409.
concepts.priority: Higher integers are leased first. Ties break FIFO by id. Default 0.
concepts.delay: Seconds to hold a message invisible after enqueue (scheduled delivery).
concepts.dedupe_key: Optional per-topic unique key. Re-enqueueing the same key returns the existing message with duplicate=true instead of creating another.

consume: 'wait' long-polls up to N seconds instead of returning an empty list immediately.
For each message returned: do the work.
If the work runs long: POST /messages/{id}/extend before the lease expires.
inspect: GET /topics -- every topic with per-state counts
GET /topics/{topic}/stats -- depth, backlog age, next scheduled delivery
recover: GET /topics/{topic}/messages?state=dead -- see what failed and why (last_error)
POST /topics/{topic}/requeue with {"state": "dead"} -- send them back to ready

errors.400: Malformed request: bad JSON, bad topic name, unknown state.
errors.401: Missing or wrong bearer token, or wrong /admin password.
errors.403: Cross-origin form post to an /admin endpoint.
errors.409: Lease conflict: wrong or expired lease_id, message not leased, or topic not empty.
errors.413: Request body exceeded the configured limit.

notes: All request and response bodies are JSON; send Content-Type: application/json.
Timestamps are float Unix epoch seconds.
A ready-made Python client is downloadable from this server -- see the 'client' key above. Prefer it over hand-rolling HTTP calls.
Leasing is at-least-once: make handlers idempotent, or use dedupe_key upstream.
